script: Decision: covered. The claimant's accidental backing into a post is a covered collision. Although the trip was for consulting business, the declared business-use surcharge and use by the named insured satisfy the business-use exception; no material gap is apparent. Next action: Approve collision coverage and assess the repair amount subject to the applicable limit and deductible.
